result.effect: 95% of relevant abstracts; specificity M = 42%, SD = 28%

cells.quote: Furthermore, we found that 95% of all relevant abstracts within a given dataset can be retrieved using heuristic stopping rules. Specifically, an approach that stops the screening process after classify -ing 20% of records and consecutively classifying 5% of irrelevant papers yielded the most significant gains in terms of specificity (M = 42%, SD = 28%).
cells.note: The study reports this mixed heuristic as the strongest stopping-rule approach, while also noting that performance depended on the learning algorithm and database characteristics.
